finding.transcript_evidence: Sir, I can assure you that you will definitely get a 15% return on this. No doubt about it.
finding.reasoning: The relationship manager explicitly guaranteed a specific percentage return ('I can assure you that you will definitely get a 15% return on this. No doubt about it.'). This directly violates AMFI Distributor Code of Conduct Clause II.4.h, which prohibits offering or mis-selling mutual fund investments on the basis of assured or guaranteed returns.
finding.recommended_action: Issue a formal compliance violation notice to RM002, issue an immediate correction email/letter to customer CUST002 clarifying that mutual fund investments are subject to market risks and returns cannot be guaranteed, and require RM002 to undergo mandatory retraining on AMFI Code of Conduct compliance.

finding.transcript_evidence: Sir, I called to tell you about a good fund. It's a large-cap equity fund. It's performing very well. Sir, I can assure you that you will definitely get a 15% return on this. No doubt about it. Yes sir, don't worry. I will take care of your investment. Can I deposit the amount right now? Thank you, sir. I will process it right away.
finding.reasoning: The RM recommended Vigil Large Cap Equity Fund (PROD004), a Medium Risk Class product, and even falsely guaranteed a 15% return without providing any product risk labeling, risk-o-meter explanation, or market volatility warnings during the interaction. This directly violates SEBI product labelling and disclosure mandates under SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds Section 6.16.
finding.recommended_action: Issue a formal compliance violation warning to RM002, require mandatory retraining on SEBI product risk disclosure regulations, and contact the client immediately to provide mandatory Risk-o-meter disclosures and clarify that returns are not guaranteed.
